column1: # ARG reporting tiers for bin/results_summary.py (CARD 4.x names; edit freely and pass with --arg-priority).
# Columns: match (name = regex searched in the ARO name, family = regex searched in the CARD AMR gene family),
# Rules are tried top to bottom and the first match wins, so put name rules before the family rule they refine.
# A name rule also wins over every family rule below it: keep genes of a tier 1 family out of the name lists
# (cfr genes match the tier 1 Cfr family rule, not the tier 2 'acquired_other' names).
# Applied before this table: any ARO with CARD SNP definitions (snps.txt), any "protein variant model" and any ARO
# whose name says "mutant" / "mutation" is tier 4 (mutation_dependent); its resistance_snp_status column says
# whether a known resistance mutation was seen.
# Applied after this table: efflux / reduced-permeability mechanisms and overexpression models are tier 3; anything
# Tiers: 1 = clinical priority (last-line resistance, usually mobile), 2 = other acquired, 3 = intrinsic,
# housekeeping, efflux or regulator, 4 = mutation dependent.
